sn46.35:1.1: Ayoniso bhikkhave manasikaroto anuppanno ceva kāmacchando uppajjati || uppanno ca kāmacchando bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati || || 3. Anuppanno ceva byāpādo uppajjati || uppanno ca byāpādo bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati || || 4. Anuppannaṃ ceva thīnamiddham uppajjati || uppannaṃ ca thīnamiddham bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati || || 5. Anuppannañceva uddhaccakukkuccam uppajjati || uppannañca uddhaccakukkuccam bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati || || 6. Ayoniso ca bhikkhave manasikaroto anuppannā ceva vicikicchā uppajjati || uppannā ca vicikicchā bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati || || 2.
sn46.35:2.1: Yoniso ca kho bhikkhave manasikaroto anuppanno ceva satisambojjhaṅgo uppajjati || uppanno ca satisambojjhaṅgo bhāvanā pāripūrim gacchati || la-[pe] || anuppanno ceva upekhāsambojjhāṅgo uppajjati || uppanno ca upekhāsambojjhaṅgo bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchatīti || || 2.
